overloadMerges.note: arrNames is filled in by the command (parameter table marks it with the '←' return arrow), so its direction should be 'out', not the syntax-position default of 'in'.

params.name: arrNames
params.description: Array of Home page folder names

params.name: filter
params.description: Name filter; supports '@' for "starts with"/"ends with"/"contains"; an empty string is ignored.
If passed, applies to the host database's folders when called from a component (otherwise ignored).
